s.note: he eats them cold straight out of the tin
s.how: Warm 2 drained tins cannellini beans in 3 tbsp olive oil with 2 sliced garlic cloves, rosemary and chilli flakes, crushing a few. Pile onto grilled sourdough. Put one cold tin of baked beans and a spoon on the side for authenticity.

s.note: the Indian diner on Rorschach's corner
s.how: Thinly slice 3 onions and mix with 1 chopped green chilli, a handful of coriander, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp turmeric, half a tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 150g chickpea flour and about 80ml water to make a thick batter that coats the onions. Drop rough spoonfuls into oil at 175C and fry 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g yoghurt with chopped mint and serve with tamarind chutney.

m.note: the Indian diner Rorschach goes to
m.how: Soften 1 onion with 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 garlic cloves. Add 2 tsp garam masala and a tin of tomatoes, then 1kg diced chicken thighs, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream. Serve with 300g basmati rice and naan.

w.note: yellow icing, one drop of red jam
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll to 5mm, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Ice yellow with 300g icing sugar, pipe two eyes and a smile in black and add a drop of strawberry jam.

d.note: Dan's kitchen late at night, Archie waiting downstairs
d.how: Steep 2 tbsp coarsely ground coffee in 240ml bourbon for 30 minutes, then strain through a paper filter. In a jug with ice, stir the bourbon with 4 tsp maple syrup and 8 dashes chocolate or aromatic bitters for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over one large cube each. Twist orange peel over each and float 3 coffee beans.
